children: Van den Bergh, who took over as CEO in 2018, purchased the shares on Thursday and Friday at an average price of 94.4p each, for a total value of £141,550.
Following the purchase, Van den Bergh holds a beneficial interest in 416,305 ordinary Trufin shares, representing approximately 0.77% of the company's issued share capital.
As of 1535 BST, Trufin shares were up 1.68% at 97p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
